ayahs.arabic: هَلۡ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ حِينࣱ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُن شَيۡـࣰٔ ا مَّذۡكُورًا
ayahs.translit: Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجࣲ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا
ayahs.translit: Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرࣰ ا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
ayahs.translit: Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَاْ وَأَغۡلَٰلࣰ ا وَسَعِيرًا
ayahs.translit: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُونَ مِن كَأۡسࣲ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
ayahs.translit: Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur

ayahs.arabic: عَيۡنࣰ ا يَشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفۡجِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance]

ayahs.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوۡمࣰ ا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسۡتَطِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread

ayahs.arabic: وَيُطۡعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسۡكِينࣰ ا وَيَتِيمࣰ ا وَأَسِيرًا
ayahs.translit: WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِوَجۡهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمۡ جَزَآءࣰ وَلَا شُكُورًا
ayahs.translit: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوسࣰ ا قَمۡطَرِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful

ayahs.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمۡ نَضۡرَةࣰ وَسُرُورࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

ayahs.arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةࣰ وَحَرِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments]

ayahs.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِۖ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيهَا شَمۡسࣰ ا وَلَا زَمۡهَرِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold

ayahs.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوفُهَا تَذۡلِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance

ayahs.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِم بِـَٔانِيَةࣲ مِّن فِضَّةࣲ وَأَكۡوَابࣲ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيرَا۠
ayahs.translit: Wayutafu AAalayhim bianiyatin min fiddatin waakwabin kanat qawareera

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass]

ayahs.arabic: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةࣲ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقۡدِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure

ayahs.arabic: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيهَا كَأۡسࣰ ا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
ayahs.translit: Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

ayahs.arabic: عَيۡنࣰ ا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلۡسَبِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel

ayahs.arabic: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَٰنࣱ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤࣰ ا مَّنثُورࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيۡتَ نَعِيمࣰ ا وَمُلۡكࣰ ا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.translit: Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion

ayahs.arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضۡرࣱ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقࣱۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةࣲ وَسَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابࣰ ا طَهُورًا
ayahs.translit: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمۡ جَزَآءࣰ وَكَانَ سَعۡيُكُم مَّشۡكُورًا
ayahs.translit: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ تَنزِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ ءَاثِمًا أَوۡ كَفُورࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever]

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةࣰ وَأَصِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَٱسۡجُدۡ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلࣰ ا طَوِيلًا
ayahs.translit: Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمࣰ ا ثَقِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day

ayahs.arabic: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنَٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَآ أَسۡرَهُمۡۖ وَإِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَآ أَمۡثَٰلَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيلًا
ayahs.translit: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذۡكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمࣰ ا
ayahs.translit: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise

ayahs.arabic: يُدۡخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمَۢا
ayahs.translit: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman

t.eng-ummmuhammad: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment
